startingCard.title: Jimmy Carter becomes president of the United States
startingCard.fact: James Earl Carter Jr. was an American politician and humanitarian who served as the 39th president of the United States from 1977 to 1981.

cards.title: ‘The Great Dictator’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Charlie Chaplin
cards.fact: The Great Dictator is a 1940 American political satire black comedy film written, directed, produced by, and starring Charlie Chaplin.

cards.title: ‘Veronica Mars’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: American television series
cards.fact: Veronica Mars is an American teen neo-noir mystery drama television series created by screenwriter Rob Thomas.

cards.title: Theodor W. Adorno dies
cards.subtitle: German philosopher, sociologist and theorist
cards.fact: Theodor W.

cards.title: Emperor Wen of Sui becomes Emperor of China
cards.fact: Emperor Wen of Sui, personal name Yang Jian (楊堅), childhood name Naluoyan (那羅延), Xianbei name Puliuru Jian (普六茹堅), was the founding emperor of the Sui dynasty of China.

cards.title: ‘Swindled’ starts
cards.subtitle: American true crime podcast
cards.fact: Swindled is an American true crime podcast written and hosted by an anonymous man who uses the pseudonym "A Concerned Citizen".

cards.title: Gourmet Foods is founded
cards.subtitle: Pakistani food manufacturer
cards.fact: Gourmet Foods is Pakistani chain of food products headquartered in Lahore, Pakistan.

cards.title: Orbit launches
cards.subtitle: Brand of chewing gum
cards.fact: Orbit, also sold in some markets as Extra, Freedent or Yida, is a brand of sugarless chewing gum from the Wrigley Company.

cards.title: ‘Unreal Engine 5’ is released
cards.subtitle: Game engine by Epic Games
cards.fact: Unreal Engine 5 (UE5) is the latest iteration of Unreal Engine, developed by Epic Games.

cards.title: Isaac Newton dies
cards.subtitle: English mathematician and physicist
cards.fact: Sir Isaac Newton was an English polymath who was a mathematician, physicist, astronomer, alchemist, theologian, author and inventor.

cards.title: ‘Young Sheldon’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: American comedy series
cards.fact: Young Sheldon is an American sitcom television series created by Chuck Lorre and Steven Molaro that aired on CBS from September 25, 2017, to May 16, 2024.

cards.title: Frank Zappa dies
cards.subtitle: American musician
cards.fact: Frank Vincent Zappa was an American composer, songwriter, guitarist, conductor, actor, satirist, filmmaker, and activist.

cards.title: Lyndon B. Johnson becomes president of the United States
cards.fact: Lyndon Baines Johnson, also known as LBJ, was the 36th president of the United States, serving from 1963 to 1969.

cards.title: Challenger 2 enters service
cards.subtitle: British main battle tank
cards.fact: The FV4034 Challenger 2 is a third generation British main battle tank (MBT) in service with the armies of the United Kingdom, Oman, and Ukraine.

cards.title: Samnite Wars begins
cards.subtitle: Conflict
cards.fact: The First, Second, and Third Samnite Wars were fought between the Roman Republic and the Samnites, who lived on a stretch of the Apennine Mountains south of Rome and north of the Lucanian tribe.The first of these wars was the result of Rome's intervention to rescue the Campanian city of Capua from a Samnite attack.

cards.title: ‘Ally McBeal’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: American legal comedy-drama television series
cards.fact: Ally McBeal is an American legal comedy-drama television series created by David E.

cards.title: ‘Other Voices’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by The Doors
cards.fact: Other Voices is the seventh studio album by the Doors, released by Elektra Records in October 1971.

cards.title: William McKinley becomes president of the United States
cards.fact: William McKinley was the 25th president of the United States, serving from 1897 until his assassination in 1901.

cards.title: ‘I'm with You’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Red Hot Chili Peppers
cards.fact: I'm with You is the tenth studio album by the American rock band Red Hot Chili Peppers.

cards.title: ‘Citizendium’ launches
cards.subtitle: Website
cards.fact: Citizendium is an English-language wiki-based free online encyclopedia launched by Larry Sanger, co-founder of Nupedia and Wikipedia.

cards.title: Golda Meir becomes prime minister of Israel
cards.fact: Golda Meir was the prime minister of Israel from 1969 to 1974.

cards.title: Alaska Airlines is founded
cards.subtitle: Airline
cards.fact: Alaska Airlines is a major airline in the United States headquartered in SeaTac, Washington, within the Seattle metropolitan area.

cards.title: ‘The Queen Is Dead’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by The Smiths
cards.fact: The Queen Is Dead is the third studio album by the English rock band the Smiths, released on 16 June 1986 by Rough Trade Records.

cards.title: Jeongjo of Joseon becomes king of Joseon Dynasty
cards.fact: Jeongjo, personal name Yi San, sometimes called Jeongjo the Great, was the 22nd monarch of the Joseon dynasty of Korea.

cards.title: ‘Wario Land 4’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Nintendo Research & Development 1
cards.fact: Wario Land 4 is a 2001 platform game developed by Nintendo R&D1 and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy Advance.

cards.title: Aldo Leopold dies
cards.subtitle: American writer and scientist
cards.fact: Aldo Leopold was an American writer, philosopher, naturalist, scientist, ecologist, forester, professor, conservationist, and environmentalist.

cards.title: Miyamoto Musashi dies
cards.subtitle: Japanese swordsman, philosopher, strategist, writer, artist, and rōnin
cards.fact: Miyamoto Musashi was a Japanese swordsman, strategist, artist, and writer who became renowned through stories of his unique double-bladed swordsmanship and undefeated record in his 62 duels.

cards.title: Calvin Coolidge becomes president of the United States
cards.fact: Calvin Coolidge was the 30th president of the United States, serving from 1923 to 1929.

cards.title: ‘Nupedia’ launches
cards.subtitle: Website
cards.fact: Nupedia was a multi-language online encyclopedia whose articles were written by volunteer contributors with relevant subject-matter expertise, reviewed by expert editors before publication, and licensed as free content.

cards.title: ‘The Graduate’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Mike Nichols
cards.fact: The Graduate is a 1967 American independent romantic comedy-drama film directed by Mike Nichols and written by Buck Henry and Calder Willingham, based on the 1963 novella by Charles Webb.

cards.title: ‘The Night Manager’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: British TV series
cards.fact: The Night Manager is a British spy thriller television serial based on the 1993 novel by John le Carré and adapted by David Farr.
